title: Orthogonal Moments in Likelihood Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.31561v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many models, such as fixed-effect models for panel or network data, are hard to estimate because they feature nuisance parameters that are both numerous and estimated imprecisely. This, in general, causes an incidental-parameter problem in the estimator of the parameters of interest. The problem can be alleviated by working with an estimating equation whose expectation is insensitive to the value of the nuisance parameters. We discuss and contrast three notions of insensitivity, also called orthogonality, in the context of likelihood models: Neyman orthogonality, Neyman orthogonality to order q, and full orthogonality. Orthogonal moments are obtained by projecting the estimating equation on nested subspaces, which are spanned by, respectively, the scores of the nuisance parameters, the first q derivatives of the likelihood ratio with respect to the nuisance parameters, and all likelihood ratios of the model. We give explicit construction

translated_abstract: 许多模型，例如面板数据或网络数据的固定效应模型，由于其含有数量众多且估计不精确的冗余参数，因而难以估计。这通常会导致感兴趣参数的估计量出现伴生参数问题。通过使用期望对冗余参数取值不敏感的估计方程，可以缓解这一问题。我们在似然模型的背景下讨论并对比了三种不敏感性（也称为正交性）的概念：Neyman正交性、q阶Neyman正交性以及完全正交性。正交矩通过将估计方程投影到嵌套子空间上获得，这些子空间分别由冗余参数的得分、似然比关于冗余参数的前q阶导数以及模型的所有似然比所张成。我们给出了显式的构造方法。
tldr: 该论文在似然模型框架下对比了三种正交性概念（Neyman正交性、q阶Neyman正交性和完全正交性），并给出了通过将估计方程投影到嵌套子空间来构造正交矩的显式方法，以缓解冗余参数导致的伴生参数问题。
en_tdlr: This paper contrasts three notions of orthogonality in likelihood models—Neyman orthogonality, Neyman orthogonality to order q, and full orthogonality—and provides explicit constructions of orthogonal moments by projecting estimating equations onto nested subspaces, alleviating the incidental-parameter problem caused by numerous imprecisely estimated nuisance parameters.
